decisive_items: Epsilon wave present in lead V4
Grossly dilated RV, high RV end diastolic volume of 219.9 mL, RVOT diameter of 31 mm, RV ejection fraction of 19.3%
Postcontrast hyperenhancement along RV free wall, RVOT apical wall, RV aspect of septum
response.rationale: R2 matches the full ARVC phenotype: epsilon wave, RV dilation/dysfunction, and MRI delayed enhancement. R1 only describes the presenting arrhythmia without addressing the structural and imaging findings that define the underlying diagnosis.

rejected.why: Wide complex tachycardia is a manifestation, not the underlying cardiomyopathy; lacks specificity for the structural RV abnormalities and epsilon wave.
